origin.description: strtrim2_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls.
origin.usage: strtrim2_sgr(x, width, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), tabs.as.spaces = getOption("fansi.tabs.as.spaces", FALSE), tab.stops = getOption("fansi.tab.stops", 8L), normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: strtrim2_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.

translation.description: strtrim2_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls.
translation.usage: strtrim2_sgr(x, width, warn=None, tabs_as_spaces=None, tab_stops=None, normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: strtrim2_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
